title: October End of Month Progress Update For My Pokemon-Inspired MMORPG
author: YuukiCrypto
selftext:
Hello everyone! 

I plan to update monthly so I don't lose traction on this massive project. Making an MMORPG is going to take over a decade, but seeing as this is my biggest hobby project, I have no qualms about that. Creating a game is about hand crafting a memorable experience. 



I don't really have any other hobbies outside of gaming and music now that programming has been murdered by an alien sentience. Creating is in my bones and its easier for me to focus on one big thing at a time.

  
Anywho, here is an updated trailer for my game Faunara. You can try it for free here: [https://playkore.com/play/fuanara/](https://playkore.com/play/fuanara/)

  
Every month I am working on animations, artstyle, menu UI, quests, guilds (factions), online, and more. The game can be played 100% offline or 100% online. 

It has online servers and you can invite your friends to explore the world of Faunara together. I added a new arcade mode where you can play online in matchmaking lobbies using the Fauna you caught while exploring the world.

  
The animations were upgraded for a majority of the 200+ fauna. I designed each with a very specific element in mind and need to go in and do the same with personality. Each Fauna will have a very distinct personality and ability that helps you during your travels.

  
Lot more has been done behind the scenes. Like a LOT more. So much that the game may not look like it's getting more polish, but it is.

  
For example, when I posted last time, the game would take 2-5 minutes just to load for people. I have spent countless hours and loops working through many different angles to figure out every piece of functionality  that was slowing us down.

  
Now, the game loads in 1-30 seconds!! I'm honestly astounded at how stress free debugging has become. I'm so ready to release this MMORPG in a decade that I can't see how I'm going to lose steam. Anyway, thanks for listening to me ramble!

Let me know if you try out Faunara! I also have it up for playtests if you want to start growing your professional playtester profile: [https://theplaytest.io/](https://theplaytest.io/)

P.S. I'm still learning how to make a decent trailer. Getting better but need to learn the real sauce to a decent game trailer. If you have any feedback on my trailer, that would be great to have :) 

P.S.S. This game is 10000% vibecoded / AI lead artist and programmer. I'm doing all the game design, story writing, quest writing, etc. Stuff that requires taste and human care.

P.S.S.S. If i was able to get funding, I would absolutely hire human artists to help me. The art and animation could use a boost but we got time.
